notes.title: 2025.8.5 Recent Updates Changelog and Future Plans
notes.notes:
2025.8.2[olist]
Continued optimizing the game, reduced input lag, reduced VRAM and RAM usage

Fixed Sword Danmaku Art being cheesable

Fixed the Stage 2 boss having incorrect bullet-firing sounds, and bullet prediction lines being wrong in Stage 1. Also fixed prediction lines sometimes showing up even without Hakurei Mind's Eye of Danmaku equipped

Fixed "Living God" being shown as "Youkai Sage" when leveling up

Fixed being able to upgrade an item twice by pressing confirm rapidly

Fixed some issues with leveling up to a youkai/Living God: Being able to continue, retry, and unlocking items under practice mode

Fixed the ninth pair of shoes being repeated

Fixed being unable to take off your hat, socks, and accessories

Fixed a collision-related replay desync in Stage 3

The stage 2 boss' hidden drops are automatically collected to avoid them being lost by accident

Display important parts of boss' hitboxes

Fixed a crash related to passive clothing abilities

Fixed some replays being unplayable

Show the version number on screen

Adjustments to the Merit Value log to prevent text overflow

Fixed some button settings not taking effect

Continue replacing assets from the original games
[/olist]

2025.8.3[olist]
Make it harder to dodge Laser Danmaku Art on the inside

Fixed getting hit in the tutorial, restarting, and capturing the first spell resulting in a failed capture being displayed

Fixed pre-spawn bullets rendering with the wrong orientation

Fixed some stage 3 boss spells having no damage resistance and thus being trivially bypassable

Fixed a crash in the settings menu

Fixed text overflow in some dialogue boxes

When holding Z to skip dialogue, also skip dialogue choices. This will not deduct Merit Value.
[/olist]

2025.8.5[olist]
Reduce the health of some spell cards so that they're capturable even without understanding the system

Make scatter-aimed bullets in stage 1 and stage 1 boss static. Refinements to the bullet shapes and fix some sprite issues

Updated the colors of some of the stage 3 boss' bullets. Some bullets have been changed to the opposite color of your favorite color for better visual distinction

Remember the last selected difficulty and shot

Add English translations. Some text may still overflow their boxes, this will be corrected in a later update.

Prompt the player to pick vocal or Touhou-style music on first start

Other: "Press C to edit character" no longer shows on Reimu and Marisa, fixed the Medium Orb Shooter's firing angles, fixed being able to continue in spell practice, fixed some typos in image resources
[/olist]

[hr][/hr]Future Plans

[olist]
Refine the settings UI
[/olist]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45700498/20a0b37a4aacc0ed32a899dd2d410356584538c8.png"]2. Continue optimizing the game

3. Add more clothing and items

4. Complete English translation

notes.title: 2025.7.31 Recent Updates Changelog and Future Plans
notes.notes:
2025.7.30 Aggregate Changelog
[olist]
Defeating any attack of a boss will auto-collect all items on screen

The player can still move when presented with dialogue choices

Increased the damage of 13 of the danmaku-firing items

Lowered the experience requirements for leveling up

Fixed a bug when you select “default" in the Character Maker

Attempt to fix a crash when opening the game

Fixed a crash when you have no spells equipped in the tutorial

Fixed the BGM not unlocking properly

Decreased the saturation of the background to avoid visibility issues

Allow entering the settings from the pause menu
[/olist]


2025.7.31 Aggregate Changelog
[olist]
Fixed a crash when reaching Level 20

Fixed the player's Level not being saved properly

Decreased the pattern difficulty on lower difficulties

Fixed some typographical errors

Fix some bugs with the makeup setting

Moved the tutorial in the main menu to avoid mistaken selections

Optimized the game and decrease VRAM demand

Changed the Amulet Bullet Shooter item, now it's easier to hit the boss with it

Added English translation for the omake

Lowered the opacity of the cherry blossoms in the Stage 2 background to improve visibility

Fixed replay issues in Stage 3

The GPU to use is now selectable in the settings. Previous lag could be due to the dedicated GPU not being properly utilized.

Fixed esc+r during a replay not restarting the replay

Defeating the Stage 3 boss no longer causes the Taking A Life penalty
[/olist]

[hr][/hr]
Future Plans:
[olist]
Add exclusive fullscreen to lower input lag

Improve the settings UI
[/olist]
